Bachelor of Technology

IIT Guwahati offers 4-year Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) programme in various disciplines through the following Departments/Schools.

Departments/SchoolsDisciplines
Computer Science and EngineeringComputer Science and Engineering
Electronics and Electrical EngineeringElectronics and Communication Engineering

Bachelor of Design

IIT Guwahati offers 4-year Bachelor of Design (B.Des) programme through the Department of Design.



Bachelor of Science

IIT Guwahati offers 4-year Bachelor of Science (BS) programme in Biomedical Science and Engineering through Jyoti and Bhupat Mehta School of Health Sciences and Technology.



BTech Minor

IIT Guwahati offers Minor programme for B.Tech students in various disciplines through the following Departments/Schools. Each Minor consists of five courses.
